name: mega-sdd-extras
description: Optional companion to mega-sdd: /mega-sdd-extras:slice turns ONE Figma page or frame (via your own Figma MCP — image or reference URL as the honest fallback) into framework-conventional UI code, render-checked through the mega-sdd Playwright MCP. Command-invocation only; never writes mega-sdd pipeline state; never starts a dev server; zero hooks, zero scripts, zero cost when not invoked.
